items.name: Xbox Loaded Accounts (US)
items.info:
Region: US
Warranty: 48 hours after delivery.
Accounts include preloaded Xbox/Microsoft balance.
No refunds/replacements after balance redemption or account modification.

items.name: 9+ iTunes Loaded Accounts (US)
items.info:
Region: US
Warranty: 24 hours after delivery.
9+ means the accounts are reliable and the balance can usually be spent immediately after login with a very low chance of suspension.

items.name: Razer Gold Loaded Accounts (Global)
items.info:
Razer Gold Loaded Accounts are accounts that already have a balance loaded onto them.
Warranty: up to 48 hours, but in most cases the account can be stored for longer.
Safe for in-game purchases with no known ban issues when used properly.
